clusters.name: helper-and-impl-refactor
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial. US-002 depends on US-001 (refactor cannot land before the helper exists). Behavior-preserving refactor of the impl path; keeping it as a single cluster makes regression easy to bisect.

clusters.name: plan-skill-changes
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial within cluster — both stories edit the same skill file, and the cleanup subcommand needs the Phase 1B branch-naming logic from US-003 to know what to delete. Depends on Phase 1 cluster because Phase 1B calls the helper extracted in US-001.

clusters.name: mirror-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Parallel-safe. US-005 lives entirely in the toolkit repo's .copilot-plugin/ subtree; US-006 lives entirely in codexu. No file overlap. Two impl members can run concurrently in separate worktrees in their respective repos.

clusters.name: e2e-smoke
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single story; smoke test consumes the merged change end-to-end. Must run after the helper, plan-skill changes, and docs all land.
